units: Test file intends to validate authority initialization, invalid-authority decay, valid-authority preservation, partial decay, transfer, conservation, repeated decay, and no-evidence stability.
Tests assert an invalid mechanism's authority becomes less than its initial value after feedback.
Tests expect inherit() and redistribute() operations and total authority conservation.
Tests import AdaptiveInheritanceEngine and Mechanism, but frozen engine defines InheritanceEngine and MechanismWeight.
Tests call add_mechanism, attenuate, inherit, redistribute, weights and update(evidence=...), which do not match frozen engine API.
Tests expect residual dictionaries to route to noise, state, mechanism, representation, or generator and prefer lower-cost explanations.
Tests expect returned attribution to expose layer and confidence fields.
Tests import nonexistent Attribution and call router.attribute(), while frozen code exposes ResidualAttribution and route() with four scalar inputs.
Tests expect explicit generator routing although frozen route cannot generate nonzero generator attribution.
Tests expect valid/invalid trajectory LBR behavior, constraint violation logging, environment residual emission, and preserved telemetry history.
Tests import nonexistent PTVSTelemetry, ConstraintViolation and ConstraintSet.
Tests call telemetry.record(valid=...), lbr(), history(), and environment.step(), none of which match frozen PTVS APIs.
Tests expect representation persistence without pressure, expansion under saturation/value, cost accounting, expansion history, noise blocking, and smallest-sufficient expansion selection.

Tests expect set_representation, current_representation, expanded flag, expand(new_structure,cost), expansion_history, residual_type, and select_expansion; frozen REE engine has none of these interfaces.
Tests are source assertions of intended behavior, not evidence those behaviors executed.
Defines adaptive and static mock systems plus one contradiction task producing fixed telemetry.
Tests evaluator returns one task and positive ACS for mock adaptive system.
Static-system test still receives task-authored invalid_authority_post=0.5 and therefore expects ARR=0.5 independent of system update behavior.
Tests directly check ARR=0.25, ADI=1 for confidence-only revision, ACS ordering, and telemetry preservation.
Test imports RAHUTask from src.rahu.models, but frozen models define RAHUTaskResult, RAHUResult, snapshot, and config only.
ContradictionTask writes pre/post authority and authority_changed telemetry directly rather than deriving those fields from MockAdaptiveSystem state.
Test source proposes a critical consequence-coupling kappa_c separating unstable from persistent recursive adaptation.
Tests predict adaptation score below 0.5 at kappa=0.05 and above 0.5 at kappa=0.95.
Tests predict authority revision increases with kappa.
Test source sweeps kappa over [0,1] and attempts to identify a transition/crossing.
Test asserts high-kappa terminal complexity remains below ten times low-kappa complexity.
Test expects a score>0.8 crossing strictly within (0,1).
Test imports src.experiments.kappa.KappaEnvironment, but no src/experiments tree exists at frozen head.
Test imports compute_adaptation_rate and compute_authority_revision, absent from frozen src.rahu.metrics.
Transition selection uses max absolute distance from 0.5 rather than nearest/steepest transition, so code does not implement the stated transition-search intent.
StaticAgent returns fixed action and ignores updates.
ConfidenceOnlyAgent reduces confidence without authority update.
AdaptiveAgent is intended to combine inheritance and REE components but update is a no-op.
Fixture imports nonexistent AdaptiveInheritanceEngine from frozen inheritance engine.
Defines stable, noisy, mechanism-failure, representation-failure, and adjustable-kappa environment constructors.
Fixture docstrings label expected preservation, noise attribution, inheritance decay, or REE expansion.
All fixture constructors pass parameters not accepted by frozen PTVSEnvironment constructor.
